text: Gas turbine output reaches 20 GW a year (about 5 GW a quarter) from Q3, 24 GW in 2028

checks.note: Q3 shipped 5 GW, 32 gas turbines (+60% y/y), including 13 aeroderivatives. The CFO said the factory ramp went well and productivity is reaching the bottom line. The 24 GW goal is tested in 2028.

text: At least 125 GW of gas turbines under contract (backlog + slots) by end-2026

checks.note: Raised for the second time: 110 → 125 → at least 130 GW. 122 GW at the end of Q3, so Q4 needs at least about 13 GW of new contracts (assuming about 5 GW shipped).
Raised to $16–17B. The guide started the year at $5.0–5.5B and has been raised three times. $15.3B already in the first nine months, leaving only $0.7–1.7B for Q4.

text: Power organic revenue growth 18–20%, segment EBITDA margin 17–19%

checks.note: Q3 margin 21.4%, even though Q3 is usually the lightest services quarter. Full-year guide raised to 19–21% growth and 19–21% margin.

text: Electrification revenue $14.5–15.0B (incl. about $3.1B from Prolec), segment EBITDA margin 18–20%

checks.note: Revenue range unchanged; Q3 margin 19.1%, and the full year is now “trending toward the higher end”.

text: Wind full-year EBITDA loss of about $400M, organic revenue down low double digits

checks.note: Loss outlook widened to $400–500M because of extra onshore services costs and the Vineyard Wind settlement; revenue now down mid-single digits, better than before. Q3 alone made a $72M profit.
